$comment: Pinned expected values for the recipes this repository authors itself. Upstream recipes are locked separately by tools/check_fidelity.py against Recipe Lab's Recipes.java; these have no upstream to compare against, so this file IS their specification. Rule enforced by tests/test_catalog.py::TestAuthoredHaveCases: an entry with source=authored-here that has no case here fails the suite, and a case pointing at anything else is dead weight. Change a value here and in catalog/filters.json together, deliberately.

cases.why: The one look the film-studio project has that Recipe Lab does not. Written here to close that gap: hard mono, grain via rough-mono, pulled a third of a stop so highlights do not clip.

Tungsten cine negative, one generation older than the Vision3 500T already in the catalog: greener, flatter. Written because Liit's public description names 'Kodak Vision 2'; which Vision2 stock it is was never stated, so 500T was chosen deliberately and said so in the note.

pe=1 toy-camera was unused by all 93 upstream recipes, and it is the only thing on this camera that produces a vignette at all. sub=2 takes the warm tint; +1/3 EV for the lightly blown look phone apps default to. sat/con/sharp are pinned to 0 because a picture effect makes the camera ignore Creative Style — pinning them here stops someone 'fixing' them later.
Same effect, cool sub-mode. Kept as a separate entry because the sub value is baked into the APK — the user cannot retint it in-camera, so the alternative has to ship as its own recipe.
pe=6 part-color, unused upstream. Selective colour is a signature phone-app move and this is the only route to it on the camera. sub=0 is red.
pe=3 posterization, unused upstream. Flat poster-like separation of tones; sub=0 is the colour variant rather than black and white.

A clean global teal. Deliberately not a split-tone: there is no tone curve on this camera, only global ab/gm, so the note says so. sat -3 stays inside the body's +/-3 slider, unlike several upstream recipes that exceed it and can only be written by the APK.
